paragraphs: Velora is an educational money-planning prototype with a sidebar workspace for the overview, markets, portfolio, planning, and extra tools. It includes light and dark themes, a playful Kid experience with plain-language definitions, and a more restrained Teen and Adult experience. Paper orders stay in the browser.

Market prices are fetched from an upstream public data source and may be delayed. Demo balances, portfolio cash, holdings, orders, default income/bills, and debt examples are synthetic. The only bank connection available is Plaid Sandbox. Velora does not execute or route securities orders, move real funds, or provide formal financial advice. Historical replay excludes taxes, fees, spreads, and actual fills. Past performance does not predict future results.

Recurring auto-invest and historical market replays are paper simulations only. The strategy scan runs while the browser app is open, up to once per minute, and can only write to the local practice ledger. It does not connect to a broker, place real orders, or move money. Plaid is Sandbox-only. Gemini and candle patterns can be wrong and do not predict returns. A live brokerage product would require a separate authorized broker integration, authenticated brokerage accounts, secure background order infrastructure, explicit customer consents, audit and kill-switch controls, and security,…

requirements.text: Adult and Teen profiles have local demo login and logout controls; logging out preserves the profile and paper ledger, and logging back in lets the user choose a color theme.
This is not password-based authentication and does not create an online financial account.
